description: Manage Cvent events: read events, register and check in attendees, keep your address book current, handle session registrations and read survey answers, and start workflows when people register, cancel or check in.

cvent_attendee_checked_in_trigger.description: Runs each time an attendee checks in to an event in Cvent. Check-ins before the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.attendee: The whole attendee as Cvent gives it, with their contact.
output.cancelled_at: When their registration was cancelled, if it was.
output.checked_in_at: When they checked in, if they have.
output.contact_id: The attendee's contact ID in the address book.
output.id: The attendee's ID, for 'Get attendee' and 'Update attendee'.
output.status: The attendee's status, such as Accepted (registered) or Cancelled.

parameters.description: Only for this event. Leave empty for every event.
parameters.name: event_id

cvent_contact_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time a contact changes in Cvent. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.contact: The whole contact as Cvent gives it.
output.title: The contact's job title.

cvent_event_updated_trigger.description: Runs each time an event changes in Cvent. Changes made before the workflow is turned on don't start it. It can watch up to 1,000. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.

output.event: The whole event as Cvent gives it.
output.event_status: Upcoming, Ongoing, Completed, Cancelled or Archived.
output.registration_status: Registration's state, such as Active or Closed.
output.title: The event's title.

cvent_new_attendee_trigger.description: Runs for each person added to an event in Cvent, whether invited or registered. Ones already there when the workflow is turned on don't start it. How often it checks follows your workspace plan.
